import math

import pytest

from subject_under_test import bistatic_doppler


def _expected_bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam):
    def unit(a, b):
        dx = b[0] - a[0]
        dy = b[1] - a[1]
        dz = b[2] - a[2]
        n = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
        return (dx / n, dy / n, dz / n)

    u_tx = unit(tx, p)
    u_rx = unit(rx, p)
    return -(
        v[0] * (u_tx[0] + u_rx[0])
        + v[1] * (u_tx[1] + u_rx[1])
        + v[2] * (u_tx[2] + u_rx[2])
    ) / lam


def test_zero_velocity_gives_zero_shift():
    p = (1000.0, 200.0, -50.0)
    v = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    tx = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    rx = (500.0, -100.0, 25.0)
    lam = 0.03
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(0.0)


def test_monostatic_approaching_target_positive_shift():
    tx = rx = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    p = (1000.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    v = (-10.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    lam = 0.03
    expected = _expected_bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam)
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(expected)


def test_monostatic_receding_target_negative_shift():
